@@ -0,0 +1,267 @@ +--- +title: Mistral Large 4 +description: "Deploy Mistral Large 4 with SGLang — the 1T-parameter (52B active) multimodal MoE with DSA sparse attention, served in FP8 on 8× NVIDIA B300 or as NVFP4 on 4× NVIDIA GB300." +tag: NEW +--- + +## Deployment + + + +```bash Command +docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:mistral-large-4 +``` + +The image ships with `mistral-common` 1.13.0 or later, required to load the checkpoints' `tekken.json`. For how to launch it, see [Install → Method 3: Using Docker](/docs/get-started/install#method-3-using-docker). Substitute the inner `sglang serve ...` with what the command generator below produces. + + + +Pick your hardware to generate the launch command: + +- **Low Latency** — fastest reply for a single user, with DSpark speculative decoding from the draft bundled in the checkpoint. Pick for chat. +- **High Throughput** — most tokens per second across many users, without speculative decoding. Best for batch jobs. + +The verified recipes are FP8 at TP8 on 8× B300, NVFP4 at TP4 on 4× GB300, and on Vera Rubin (arm64) FP8 at TP8 across two 4-GPU trays or NVFP4 at TP4 on one tray. Commands for other GPUs are badged **Not Verified**; combinations without a command explain why in the panel. Every command carries `--reasoning-parser auto --tool-call-parser auto`: without them, reasoning and tool calls come back as raw text in `content`. + +import { Deployment } from "/src/snippets/_deployment.jsx"; +import { config } from "/src/snippets/configs/mistralai/mistral-large-4.jsx"; +import { benchmarks } from "/src/snippets/configs/mistralai/mistral-large-4-benchmarks.jsx"; + + + +## Playground + +The Playground is where you experiment with **SGLang features beyond the verified matrix**. The Deploy panel above only emits combinations the SGLang team has signed off on; the Playground lets you turn on additional knobs on top of whichever cell the Deploy panel is currently showing. + +import { Playground } from "/src/snippets/_playground.jsx"; + + + +## 1. Model Introduction + +**Mistral Large 4** is Mistral AI's 1T-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 52B active parameters and a vision encoder. It has 72 layers with 128 routed experts (top-4) plus one shared expert, multi-head latent attention with DSA sparse attention, and cross-layer KV sharing. The checkpoints declare a native 1,048,576-token context and bundle a DSpark draft model for speculative decoding. + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + +
CheckpointWeightsHardware
[`mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B`](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B)FP8 E4M3, 128×128 block scales8× B300, two Vera Rubin trays
[`mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B-NVFP4`](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B-NVFP4)NVFP4 routed experts, block-FP8 attention and dense layersBlackwell only: 4× GB300, one Vera Rubin tray
+ +**Recommended generation:** `temperature=1.0`, `top_p=0.95` (the checkpoint's `generation_config.json` defaults; informational — do not hardcode in client code). + +**License:** Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License; see the model card. + +**Resources:** HuggingFace [FP8](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B) and [NVFP4](https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B-NVFP4). + +## 2. Benchmarks + +Accuracy uses `sgl-eval` at temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95, at most 8,192 output tokens and `reasoning_effort` `low`, unless noted. Speed uses `bench_serving` with 1,024-token random prompts and 512 output tokens, 64 requests per concurrency point and a flushed cache; total tok/s/GPU counts input and output tokens. The benchmark card of each recipe carries the full protocol and a ⚡ Reproduce button. + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + +
HardwareRecipeResult
8× B300FP8, TP8, FP8 KVGSM8K **96.74%** (1,319 questions, all stopped); **774** total tok/s/GPU at concurrency 64
8× B300FP8, TP8, DSpark**3.71** accepted tokens per 4-token verify step; **1,018** total tok/s/GPU at concurrency 64
4× GB300NVFP4, TP4GSM8K, first 100 questions: **98%** at `low`, 97–98% at `high`; MMMU-Pro **72.43%** (seed 1); **1,560** total tok/s/GPU at concurrency 64
4× GB300NVFP4, TP4, DSpark**3.69** accepted tokens per 4-token verify step; **2,812** total tok/s/GPU at concurrency 64
Vera Rubin, two traysFP8, TP8, BF16 KVGSM8K **96.64%**, MMLU **91.70%**, MMMU-Pro **72.22%** (mean of 3 seeds)
Vera Rubin, one trayNVFP4, TP4, BF16 KVGSM8K **96.74%**, MMLU **91.64%**, MMMU-Pro **72.66%** (mean of 3 seeds)
+ +## 3. Configuration Tips + +- **Parsers.** `auto` resolves to the `mistral` reasoning and tool-call parsers; `--reasoning-parser mistral --tool-call-parser mistral` is equivalent. Without a reasoning parser the reasoning stays inline in `content` as `[THINK]…[/THINK]`; without a tool-call parser tool calls come back as `[TOOL_CALLS]…` text. +- **Tokenizer.** By default the server tokenizes with the checkpoint's `tokenizer.json` and renders `chat_template.jinja`, which is token-identical to `mistral-common` for chat prompts. `--tokenizer-mode mistral` tokenizes through `mistral-common` instead. Either way `mistral-common` 1.13.0 or later is required: earlier versions cannot load the checkpoints' `tekken.json`. +- **Context and KV cache.** Leave `--context-length` unset for the native 1,048,576 tokens. The KV cache defaults to FP8 (E4M3) on Blackwell and Vera Rubin and BF16 on Hopper; on 8× B300 at `--mem-fraction-static 0.85` the FP8 KV pool holds about 2.49M tokens, and about 1.34M with `--kv-cache-dtype bfloat16`. +- **DSpark.** The server loads the bundled draft from the checkpoint (3 drafted tokens, 4-token verify step); do not pass `--speculative-draft-model-path` or draft-length flags. With speculative decoding `--max-running-requests` defaults to 48. For bursts of short requests, `--max-running-requests 64` raises throughput (the GB300 Low Latency recipe sets it); keep 48 or lower for long-context traffic. +- **Long prompts.** Prefill CP 2 (Playground → **Attention** → **Prefill CP**) on top of the Low Latency recipe lowers long-prompt TTFT at a small decode cost. +- **KV capacity.** **Decode Context Parallel (DCP)** and **HiSparse** in the Playground hold more tokens at a decode-throughput cost. Neither combines with prefill CP. +- **Vera Rubin.** The generated commands carry the environment variables of the measured runs; tokenizer, context and KV dtype resolve from the checkpoint like on other hardware. The `mistral-large-4` image is multi-arch (amd64 + arm64). + +## 4. Advanced Usage + +### 4.1 Reasoning + +The reasoning comes back in `reasoning_content` and the answer in `content`. `reasoning_effort` accepts `low`, `medium` and `high`; a request that omits it reasons at the checkpoint default, `high`, and `"none"` returns HTTP 400. + + + +```python Example +from openai import OpenAI + +client = OpenAI(base_url="http://localhost:30000/v1", api_key="EMPTY") +resp = client.chat.completions.create( + model="mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B", + messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "A train travels 120 km in 1.5 hours. What is its average speed in km/h? Answer briefly."}], + reasoning_effort="high", +) +msg = resp.choices[0].message +print("Reasoning:", msg.reasoning_content) +print("Answer:", msg.content) +``` + + + + + +```text Output +Reasoning: The user wants me to calculate the average speed of a train that travels 120 km in 1.5 hours. + + The formula for average speed is: + Speed = Distance / Time + + Given: + - Distance = 120 km + - Time = 1.5 hours + + Calculation: + Speed = 120 km / 1.5 hours + Speed = 80 km/h + + The user asked for a brief answer, so I should just provide the numerical answer with units. + + 120 / 1.5 = 80 + + So the answer is 80 km/h. +Answer: 80 km/h +``` + + + +### 4.2 Image Input + +Images go in OpenAI-style `image_url` content parts, as URLs or base64 data URLs. + + + +```python Example +import base64, io +from openai import OpenAI +from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont + +img = Image.new("RGB", (448, 448), "white") +draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img) +draw.ellipse((60, 60, 388, 388), fill="red") +draw.text((150, 140), "42", fill="white", font=ImageFont.load_default(size=140)) +buf = io.BytesIO() +img.save(buf, format="PNG") +url = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode() + +client = OpenAI(base_url="http://localhost:30000/v1", api_key="EMPTY") +resp = client.chat.completions.create( + model="mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B", + messages=[{"role": "user", "content": [ + {"type": "text", "text": "What number is written in the image, and what color is the circle? Answer briefly."}, + {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": url}}, + ]}], +) +print(resp.choices[0].message.content) +``` + + + + + +```text Output +The number written in the image is **42**, and the circle is **red**. +``` + + + +### 4.3 Tool Calling + +Function calls come back as structured `tool_calls` with `finish_reason` `tool_calls`. + + + +```python Example +from openai import OpenAI + +client = OpenAI(base_url="http://localhost:30000/v1", api_key="EMPTY") +tools = [{ + "type": "function", + "function": { + "name": "get_weather", + "description": "Get the current weather for a city.", + "parameters": { + "type": "object", + "properties": {"city": {"type": "string", "description": "City name"}}, + "required": ["city"], + }, + }, +}] +resp = client.chat.completions.create( + model="mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B", + messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "What is the weather in Paris?"}], + tools=tools, +) +choice = resp.choices[0] +print("finish_reason:", choice.finish_reason) +for call in choice.message.tool_calls: + print(call.function.name, call.function.arguments) +``` + + + + + +```text Output +finish_reason: tool_calls +get_weather {"city": "Paris"} +``` + + + +## 5. Known Limitations + +- **Pipeline parallelism** must keep layer 35 and the layers that read its KV cache on one stage (`SGLANG_PP_LAYER_PARTITION=35,37` for two stages). DSpark accepts pipeline parallelism only on a PD prefill server. +- **PD disaggregation** runs with a peer-config fingerprint guard; a 1P1D setup (one prefill and one decode server) is validated end to end. +- **Prefill CP with DCP** is unsupported; the server rejects the combination at startup. +- **KV-cache sharding** (`--enable-kv-cache-sharding`) is unsupported with the model's cross-layer KV sharing; the server rejects it at startup.
